hidden.title: unknown principal is denied even by a wildcard allow (ids are case-sensitive)
inherits naming a user or an unknown id is ignored
cycles and self-loops in inheritance; a role can make requests
tag resolution: own tag first, then smallest distance, then smallest id; empty value is present
a missing tag matches nothing; in not_resources it therefore excludes nothing
substituted text is literal: * and ? inside an id or tag value match only themselves
escapes ${*} ${?} ${$}; a $ not followed by { and a bare { are ordinary
invalid references make the statement malformed; actions have no references
[ and ] are ordinary; * crosses / and :; ? is exactly one character
action case folding is ASCII-only; resources and principal ids are case-sensitive
malformed statements: effect case, bare strings, empty or doubled lists, unknown keys
malformed statements: principals in a boundary statement, missing in an identity one, bad set
a role's boundary applies to everyone who inherits it; a set with no statements contains nothing
identity deny beats the boundary; boundary denies are listed only under outside_boundary
every boundary set must contain the request; duplicate sids are listed once
plain negated operator: true for a missing key, false for an empty list, any-value for lists
ForAllValues is true for a missing key or an empty list; ForAnyValue is false for both
IfExists is true for a missing key and changes nothing for a present one
keys and operators combine with AND, values with OR; an empty operator dict imposes nothing
numbers: strict ASCII grammar, exact comparison
numbers compare exactly; NumericNotEquals on a non-number is false; a bad policy number
Bool is exact; Null tests presence (true = absent); Null takes no prefix or suffix
operator names: prefix plus suffix is valid; wrong case, doubled parts and bad values are not
principal patterns match any member of the identity set, wildcards included
allowed lists every matching identity allow, without duplicates, in code-point order
explicit_deny lists every matching identity deny, whatever the statement order
boundary statements have no principals and resolve references for the request principal
glob edge cases: empty pattern, doubled stars, overlapping literal segments
StringLike / StringNotLike: no references, [ is ordinary, negated base on a missing key
